description: This file defines a Java interface 'CredentialsClientFactory' in the package 'org.eclipse.hono.client'. It declares methods for creating instances of credentials clients for Hono's Credentials API, including factory creation methods with optional cache provider, and a method to retrieve or create a credentials client for a specific tenant. It also references implementation class 'CredentialsClientFactoryImpl' and related types like 'HonoConnection' and 'CacheProvider'.

classes.name: CredentialsClientFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating credentials clients and related resources for Hono's Credentials API.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new CredentialsClientFactory instance using an existing connection, with an optional cache provider.

methods.name: getOrCreateCredentialsClient
methods.description: Returns a future that completes with a credentials client for a specified tenant, creating it if necessary.
